GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 386.6 (7 Apr 48) CPC/LP
(SCAPIN - 1878/2)
APO 500
4 September 1948
MEMORANDUM FOR : JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
SUBJECT : Concentration of Looted Raw Materials Impounded under SCAPIN 1878.
1. Reference is made to the following:
a. File AG 410.2(7 Apr 48)CPC/FP, SCAPIN 1378, 7 April 1948, subject, "Property Produced in Occupied Areas," from General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers
b. File AG 410.2(15 Jun 48)CPC/LP, SCAPIN 1878/1, 15 June 1948, subject, "Suspension of Action Directed in SCAPIN 1878," from General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers
c. C.L.C.O. No. 2328 (CPB No. 808) 22 June 1948, subject, "Property Produced in Occupied Areas," from the Japanese Government.
2, The Japanese Government is hereby informed that reference memorandum 1b is rescinded, and that the provisions of paragraph 4, reference memorandum 1a are again in full effect.
3. In compliance with reference memorandum 1a above, therefore, the property listed in reference memorandum 1c will be placed in storage at the Osaka and Nagoya Looked Property warehouses, by 5 October 1948.
4. Further instructions will be issued regarding the warehouses in which the remainder of the property impounded under reference memorandum 1a above is to be concentrated.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
R.M. LEVY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
